last_summary: Video A has direct evidence of thinly slicing scallions, finely chopping parsley with a knife, and processing parsley/scallions in a food processor. Video B has direct evidence of already chopped tomatoes and parsley, chopped green onions being added, and mixing, but the cited intervals do not show active vegetable cutting or processing. Open work is to locate any visible Video B vegetable-preparation actions and compare them with Video A's preparation methods without inferring absence.
